about_templates.HTML, CSS and JS: One page with a stylesheet and a script. Opens in the preview; nothing to install.
about_templates.TypeScript: A main.ts that runs on the bundled Node with Ctrl+F5. For learning the language.
about_templates.Vite: HTML, CSS and JS served by Vite, with instant reload and a build for publishing. Installs with npm on first run.
about_templates.Vite + React: A React app with Vite. The preview runs npm run dev for you. Installs with npm on first run.
about_templates.Node.js server: A small HTTP server with no dependencies. npm run dev restarts it on save; requests.http tries it.
